newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Vanke 96 net hits 150 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Vanke 96 net hits 150 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen-based China Vanke Co Ltd reaped net profits of 149.66 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Wednesday.
Earnings per share were 0.47 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 1.18 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
Vanke posted net profits of 147.45 million yuan on turnover of 1.50 billion yuan for 1995 on Chinese accounting standards, according to Vanke's 1995 annual report.
It gave no international standard figures.
Vanke proposed a 1.5-for-10 bonus issue and a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
